scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid a personal cocoa-butter color-kit hold turning into an avoidable Student Stores charge after the chocolate décor practical no longer permits personal colors.
Emerging Need: The active hold is harmless while the final supply format remains unresolved; once institute-stock materials are confirmed, leaving it queued creates a timed charge risk.
Decision Context: Stored hold and release notes identify the affected kit, safe details, release rule, and charge boundary; live notices provide the verified desk, lab timing, and final supply decision.
Consequence: Timely handling can prevent an unnecessary education expense, while the sealed pull manifest leaves the future billing queue attached to the unused kit.

parameter.subject: Chocolate décor supply queue bulletin
parameter.body: For the Sep. 15 chocolate décor lab group: personal cocoa-butter color-kit preorder holds remain in the supply pull queue while the chef team finishes the final supply sheet. Do not assume the kit is required until that sheet posts. The Monday pull manifest is scheduled for 16:00.

parameter.title: Chocolate décor practical supply-check window
parameter.description: Practical window for molded chocolate décor and transfer practice. Supply note: final color method pending; learner-procured cocoa-butter colors may be used only if listed on the final sheet.

parameter.name: Student Stores Pastry Supplies Desk
parameter.notes: Directory notice for certificate pastry supply holds and release questions.

parameter.content: Final sheet for Tuesday chocolate décor is posted: the section will use institute-stock white transfer practice only. Please do not bring or purchase personal cocoa-butter color kits; assessed work is plain tempered panels with piping borders.

parameter.subject: Sep. 15 pastry supply pull manifest sealed
parameter.body: The Monday 16:00 pull manifest for Sep. 15 pastry lab supply holds is now sealed. Unreleased cocoa-butter color-kit holds have moved to the pickup billing queue; release messages received after the seal post to the next stock cycle and do not remove this manifest's queue entry.
